executivePulse.interpretation: The situation in memory and AI infrastructure remains strained. Server DRAM / RDIMM, HBM and Enterprise SSDs are currently among the tightest areas. The Daily Check of 2026-08-23 reviewed eight relevant reports; there is presently no confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and improved yields can ease pressure but will reach the market with delay. For buyers, securing supply, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
